summary: Phase 5.2 Decision Trace Standard testing complete. 30/30 pytest tests PASSED. All endpoints return 200. Frontend /admin/futures/risk-monitor diagnostics section renders all widgets correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Decision trace model (decision_trace_model.py): Correctly implements tek contract with all 14 required fields: trace_id, timestamp, symbol, strategy, side, signal_confidence, regime, microstructure_result, risk_result, liquidation_result, adl_result, final_decision, reason_code, decision_layer

Reason code taxonomy (reason_codes.py): All 13 codes tekilleştirildi - SIGNAL_WEAK, MICROSTRUCTURE_SPREAD_SHOCK/DEPTH_COLLAPSE/SLIPPAGE_ANOMALY, RISK_LEVERAGE_LIMIT/MARGIN_USAGE, LIQUIDATION_DISTANCE_TOO_LOW, CASCADE_DETECTED, ADL_PRESSURE_LONG/SHORT, POLICY_BLOCK, GATE_REJECT, ALLOW
Decision attribution (decision_attribution_engine.py): Deterministic attribution implemented - layer priority: STRATEGY > MICROSTRUCTURE > RISK_ENGINE > LIQUIDATION > ADL > POLICY > GATE
Paper decision flow (futures_paper_decision_flow.py): Updated chain çalışıyor - signal -> microstructure -> risk -> liquidation -> ADL -> policy -> gate -> attribution -> trace -> paper execution
GET /api/admin/futures/decision-diagnostics: Returns contract with false_allow_count, false_reject_count, gate_reason_distribution, confidence_vs_result, decision_layer_distribution

Frontend /admin/futures/risk-monitor: Diagnostics section renders with False Allow Counter, False Reject Counter, Gate Reason Distribution, Confidence vs Outcome Scatter, Decision Layer Distribution widgets
System remains paper-only - no live trading execution
seed_data_creation: None - diagnostics data generated from live paper cycle
